using Dates
using Logging

function _get_leaving_atom_mask(struc, polymer_ligand_bonds, ligand_ligand_bonds, chain_id::String, chain_type::String, res_id::Int, res_name::String)
    bonded_atoms = get_bonded_atoms(polymer_ligand_bonds, ligand_ligand_bonds, res_id, chain_id)
    drop_atoms = get_link_drop_atoms(res_name=res_name, chain_type=chain_type, is_start_terminus=false, is_end_terminus=false, bonded_atoms=bonded_atoms, drop_ligand_leaving_atoms=true)
    drop_atom_filter_atoms = struc.chain_id .!= struc.chain_id
    for drop_atom in drop_atoms
        drop_atom_filter_atom = (struc.atom_name .== drop_atom) .& (struc.chain_id .== chain_id) .& (struc.res_id .== res_id)
        drop_atom_filter_atoms = drop_atom_filter_atoms .| drop_atom_filter_atom
    end
    return drop_atom_filter_atoms
end

function clean_structure(struc, ccd; drop_missing_sequence::Bool, filter_clashes::Bool, drop_non_standard_atoms::Bool, filter_crystal_aids::Bool, filter_waters::Bool, filter_hydrogens::Bool, filter_leaving_atoms::Bool, only_glycan_ligands_for_leaving_atoms::Bool, covalent_bonds_only::Bool, remove_polymer_polymer_bonds::Bool, remove_bad_bonds::Bool, remove_nonsymmetric_bonds::Bool)
    metadata = Dict{String, Any}()
    if filter_crystal_aids && struc.structure_method in CRYSTALLIZATION_METHODS
        struc = filter_out(struc, res_name=COMMON_CRYSTALLIZATION_AIDS)
    end
    if drop_missing_sequence
        chains_with_unk_sequence = find_chains_with_unknown_sequence(struc)
        num_with_unk_sequence = length(chains_with_unk_sequence)
        if !isempty(chains_with_unk_sequence)
            struc = filter_out(struc, chain_id=chains_with_unk_sequence)
        end
    else
        num_with_unk_sequence = 0
    end
    metadata["num_with_unk_sequence"] = num_with_unk_sequence
    if filter_clashes && struc.num_chains > 1
        clashing_chains = find_clashing_chains(struc)
        if !isempty(clashing_chains)
            struc = filter_out(struc, chain_id=clashing_chains)
        end
    else
        clashing_chains = []
    end
    metadata["num_clashing_chains_removed"] = length(clashing_chains)
    metadata["chains_removed"] = clashing_chains
    if drop_non_standard_atoms
        struc = drop_non_standard_atoms(struc, ccd=ccd, drop_unk=false, drop_non_ccd=false)
    end
    struc = struc.with_sorted_chains
    if filter_hydrogens
        struc = without_hydrogen(struc)
    end
    if filter_waters
        struc = filter_out(struc, chain_type=WATER)
    end
    if filter_leaving_atoms
        drop_leaving_atoms_all = struc.chain_id .!= struc.chain_id
        polymer_ligand_bonds = get_polymer_ligand_bonds(struc, only_glycan_ligands=only_glycan_ligands_for_leaving_atoms)
        ligand_ligand_bonds = get_ligand_ligand_bonds(struc, only_glycan_ligands=only_glycan_ligands_for_leaving_atoms)
        all_glycans = union(Set(GLYCAN_OTHER_LIGANDS), Set(GLYCAN_LINKING_LIGANDS))
        if only_glycan_ligands_for_leaving_atoms && (!any(ligand_ligand_bonds.atom_name .== "O1")) && (!any(polymer_ligand_bonds.atom_name .== "O1"))
            drop_leaving_atoms_all = (struc.atom_name .== "O1") .& (in.(struc.res_name, Ref(all_glycans)))
        else
            substruct = struc.group_by_residue
            glycan_mask = in.(substruct.res_name, Ref(all_glycans))
            substruct = filter(substruct, glycan_mask)
            for res in iter_residues(substruct)
                res_name = res["res_name"]
                if res_name in all_glycans
                    drop_atom_filter = _get_leaving_atom_mask(struc, polymer_ligand_bonds, ligand_ligand_bonds, res["chain_id"], res["chain_type"], res["res_id"], res_name)
                    drop_leaving_atoms_all = drop_leaving_atoms_all .| drop_atom_filter
                end
            end
        end
        num_atoms_before = struc.num_atoms
        struc = filter_out(struc, drop_leaving_atoms_all)
        num_atoms_after = struc.num_atoms
        if num_atoms_before > num_atoms_after
            @error "Dropped $(num_atoms_before - num_atoms_after) atoms from GT struc: chain_id $(struc.chain_id) res_id $(struc.res_id) res_name $(struc.res_name)"
        end
    end
    if !isnothing(struc.bonds) && covalent_bonds_only
        is_covalent = in.(struc.bonds.type, Ref(["covale"]))
        if sum(is_covalent) > 0
            new_bonds = struc.bonds[is_covalent]
        else
            new_bonds = make_empty_bonds()
        end
        struc = copy_and_update(struc, bonds=new_bonds)
    end
    if !isnothing(struc.bonds) && (remove_bad_bonds || remove_polymer_polymer_bonds)
        include_bond = Bool[]
        num_pp_bonds = 0
        num_bad_bonds = 0
        for bond in iter_bonds(struc)
            dest_atom = bond.dest_atom
            from_atom = bond.from_atom
            if remove_polymer_polymer_bonds
                if (from_atom["chain_type"] in POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES) && (dest_atom["chain_type"] in POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES)
                    num_pp_bonds += 1
                    push!(include_bond, false)
                    continue
                end
            end
            if remove_bad_bonds
                dest_coords = [dest_atom["atom_x"], dest_atom["atom_y"], dest_atom["atom_z"]]
                from_coords = [from_atom["atom_x"], from_atom["atom_y"], from_atom["atom_z"]]
                squared_dist = sum((dest_coords .- from_coords).^2)
                squared_threshold = 2.4 * 2.4
                if squared_dist > squared_threshold
                    num_bad_bonds += 1
                    push!(include_bond, false)
                    continue
                end
            end
            push!(include_bond, true)
        end
        if sum(include_bond) < length(struc.bonds)
            @info "Reducing number of bonds for $(struc.name) from $(length(struc.bonds)) to $(sum(include_bond)), of which $(num_pp_bonds) are polymer-polymer bonds and $(num_bad_bonds) are bad bonds."
            if sum(include_bond) > 0
                new_bonds = struc.bonds[include_bond]
            else
                new_bonds = make_empty_bonds()
            end
            struc = copy_and_update(struc, bonds=new_bonds)
        end
    end
    if !isnothing(struc.bonds) && remove_nonsymmetric_bonds
        polymer_ligand_bonds = get_polymer_ligand_bonds(struc, only_glycan_ligands=false)
        if !isnothing(polymer_ligand_bonds)
            if has_nonsymmetric_bonds_on_symmetric_polymer_chains(struc, polymer_ligand_bonds)
                from_atom_idxs, dest_atom_idxs = get_atom_indices(struc.bonds, struc.atom_key)
                poly_chain_types = collect(POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES)
                is_polymer_bond = (in.(struc.chain_type[from_atom_idxs], Ref(poly_chain_types))) .| (in.(struc.chain_type[dest_atom_idxs], Ref(poly_chain_types)))
                struc = copy_and_update(struc, bonds=struc.bonds[.!is_polymer_bond])
            end
        end
    end
    return struc, metadata
end

function create_empty_output_struc_and_layout(struc, ccd; with_hydrogens::Bool=false, skip_unk::Bool=false, polymer_ligand_bonds=nothing, ligand_ligand_bonds=nothing, drop_ligand_leaving_atoms::Bool=false)
    bonded_atom_pairs = []
    if !isnothing(polymer_ligand_bonds)
        for (chain_ids, res_ids, atom_names) in zip(polymer_ligand_bonds.chain_id, polymer_ligand_bonds.res_id, polymer_ligand_bonds.atom_name)
            push!(bonded_atom_pairs, ((chain_ids[1], res_ids[1], atom_names[1]), (chain_ids[2], res_ids[2], atom_names[2])))
        end
    end
    if !isnothing(ligand_ligand_bonds)
        for (chain_ids, res_ids, atom_names) in zip(ligand_ligand_bonds.chain_id, ligand_ligand_bonds.res_id, ligand_ligand_bonds.atom_name)
            push!(bonded_atom_pairs, ((chain_ids[1], res_ids[1], atom_names[1]), (chain_ids[2], res_ids[2], atom_names[2])))
        end
    end
    residues = residues_from_structure(struc, include_missing_residues=true)
    flat_output_layout = make_flat_atom_layout(residues, ccd=ccd, with_hydrogens=with_hydrogens, skip_unk_residues=skip_unk, polymer_ligand_bonds=polymer_ligand_bonds, ligand_ligand_bonds=ligand_ligand_bonds, drop_ligand_leaving_atoms=drop_ligand_leaving_atoms)
    empty_output_struc = make_structure(flat_layout=flat_output_layout, atom_coords=zeros(size(flat_output_layout, 1), 3), name=struc.name, atom_b_factors=nothing, all_physical_residues=residues)
    if !isempty(bonded_atom_pairs)
        empty_output_struc = add_bonds(empty_output_struc, bonded_atom_pairs, bond_type=COVALENT_BOND)
    end
    return empty_output_struc, flat_output_layout
end

using LinearAlgebra

VALID_DTYPES = [Float32, Float64, Int8, Int32, Int64, Bool]

function remove_invalidly_typed_feats(batch::Dict)::Dict
    return Dict(k => v for (k, v) in batch if hasfield(typeof(v), :dtype) && v.dtype in VALID_DTYPES)
end

function bfloat16_getter(next_getter, value, context)
    if context.original_dtype == BFloat16
        if value.dtype != BFloat16
            value = convert(BFloat16, value)
        end
    end
    return next_getter(value)
end

function bfloat16_context(f)
    custom_getter(bfloat16_getter) do
        f()
    end
end

function mask_mean(mask, value; axis=nothing, keepdims=false, eps=1e-10)
    mask_shape = size(mask)
    value_shape = size(value)
    @assert length(mask_shape) == length(value_shape) "Shapes are not compatible, shapes: $(mask_shape), $(value_shape)"
    if isa(axis, Integer)
        axis = [axis]
    elseif isnothing(axis)
        axis = collect(1:length(mask_shape))
    end
    @assert isa(axis, AbstractVector) "axis needs to be either an iterable, integer or \"nothing\""
    broadcast_factor = 1.0
    for axis_ in axis
        value_size = value_shape[axis_]
        mask_size = mask_shape[axis_]
        if mask_size == 1
            broadcast_factor *= value_size
        else
            error_msg = "Shapes are not compatible, shapes: $(mask_shape), $(value_shape)"
            @assert mask_size == value_size error_msg
        end
    end
    return sum(mask .* value, dims=axis, keepdims=keepdims) ./ max.(sum(mask, dims=axis, keepdims=keepdims) .* broadcast_factor, eps)
end

using LinearAlgebra

mutable struct DistogramFeaturesConfig
    min_bin::Float64
    max_bin::Float64
    num_bins::Int
    DistogramFeaturesConfig(; min_bin=3.25, max_bin=50.75, num_bins=39) = new(min_bin, max_bin, num_bins)
end

function dgram_from_positions(positions, config::DistogramFeaturesConfig)
    lower_breaks = range(config.min_bin, config.max_bin, length=config.num_bins)
    lower_breaks = lower_breaks .^ 2
    upper_breaks = vcat(lower_breaks[2:end], [1e8])
    positions_expanded_2 = reshape(positions, size(positions, 1), 1, size(positions, 2))
    positions_expanded_3 = reshape(positions, 1, size(positions, 1), size(positions, 2))
    dist2 = sum((positions_expanded_2 .- positions_expanded_3).^2, dims=3)
    dgram = zeros(Float32, size(dist2, 1), size(dist2, 2), config.num_bins)
    for i in 1:config.num_bins
        dgram[:, :, i] = (dist2[:, :, 1] .> lower_breaks[i]) .& (dist2[:, :, 1] .< upper_breaks[i])
    end
    return dgram
end

function make_backbone_rigid(positions, mask, group_indices)
    backbone_indices = group_indices[:, 1, :]
    c = backbone_indices[:, 3]
    b = backbone_indices[:, 2]
    a = backbone_indices[:, 1]
    slice_index(x, i) = [x[j, i[j]] for j in 1:length(i)]
    rigid_mask = Float32.(slice_index(mask, a) .* slice_index(mask, b) .* slice_index(mask, c))
    frame_positions = []
    for indices in [a, b, c]
        push!(frame_positions, [positions[j, indices[j]] for j in 1:length(indices)])
    end
    rotation = Rot3Array_from_two_vectors(frame_positions[3] .- frame_positions[2], frame_positions[1] .- frame_positions[2])
    rigid = Rigid3Array(rotation, frame_positions[2])
    return rigid, rigid_mask
end

mutable struct TemplateEmbeddingConfig
    num_channels::Int
    template_stack
    dgram_features::DistogramFeaturesConfig
    TemplateEmbeddingConfig(; num_channels=64, template_stack=nothing, dgram_features=DistogramFeaturesConfig()) = new(num_channels, template_stack, dgram_features)
end

mutable struct TemplateEmbedding
    config::TemplateEmbeddingConfig
    global_config
    name::String
    TemplateEmbedding(config, global_config; name="template_embedding") = new(config, global_config, name)
end

function (te::TemplateEmbedding)(query_embedding, templates, padding_mask_2d, multichain_mask_2d, key)
    c = te.config
    num_residues = size(query_embedding, 1)
    num_templates = size(templates.aatype, 1)
    query_num_channels = size(query_embedding, 3)
    num_atoms = 24
    @assert size(query_embedding) == (num_residues, num_residues, query_num_channels)
    @assert size(templates.aatype) == (num_templates, num_residues)
    @assert size(templates.atom_positions) == (num_templates, num_residues, num_atoms, 3)
    @assert size(templates.atom_mask) == (num_templates, num_residues, num_atoms)
    @assert size(padding_mask_2d) == (num_residues, num_residues)
    num_templates = size(templates.aatype, 1)
    num_res = size(query_embedding, 1)
    query_num_channels = size(query_embedding, 3)
    template_embedder = SingleTemplateEmbedding(te.config, te.global_config)
    subkeys = split_key(key, num_templates)
    function scan_fn(carry, x)
        template, key_i = x
        embedding = template_embedder(query_embedding, template, padding_mask_2d, multichain_mask_2d, key_i)
        return carry .+ embedding, nothing
    end
    scan_init = zeros(eltype(query_embedding), num_res, num_res, c.num_channels)
    summed_template_embeddings, _ = scan(scan_fn, scan_init, (templates, subkeys))
    embedding = summed_template_embeddings ./ (1e-7 + num_templates)
    embedding = relu.(embedding)
    embedding = Linear(query_num_channels, initializer="relu", name="output_linear")(embedding)
    @assert size(embedding) == (num_residues, num_residues, query_num_channels)
    return embedding
end

mutable struct SingleTemplateEmbedding
    config::TemplateEmbeddingConfig
    global_config
    name::String
    SingleTemplateEmbedding(config, global_config; name="single_template_embedding") = new(config, global_config, name)
end

function (ste::SingleTemplateEmbedding)(query_embedding, templates, padding_mask_2d, multichain_mask_2d, key)
    gc = ste.global_config
    c = ste.config
    @assert eltype(padding_mask_2d) == eltype(query_embedding)
    dtype = eltype(query_embedding)
    num_channels = ste.config.num_channels
    function construct_input(query_embedding, templates, multichain_mask_2d)
        aatype = templates.aatype
        dense_atom_mask = templates.atom_mask
        dense_atom_positions = templates.atom_positions
        dense_atom_positions = dense_atom_positions .* reshape(dense_atom_mask, size(dense_atom_mask)..., 1)
        pseudo_beta_positions, pseudo_beta_mask = pseudo_beta_fn(templates.aatype, dense_atom_positions, dense_atom_mask)
        pseudo_beta_mask_2d = pseudo_beta_mask[:, :] .* pseudo_beta_mask[:, :]'
        pseudo_beta_mask_2d = pseudo_beta_mask_2d .* multichain_mask_2d
        dgram = dgram_from_positions(pseudo_beta_positions, ste.config.dgram_features)
        dgram = dgram .* reshape(pseudo_beta_mask_2d, size(pseudo_beta_mask_2d)..., 1)
        dgram = convert.(dtype, dgram)
        pseudo_beta_mask_2d = convert.(dtype, pseudo_beta_mask_2d)
        to_concat = [(dgram, 1), (pseudo_beta_mask_2d, 0)]
        aatype_onehot = onehot(aatype, POLYMER_TYPES_NUM_WITH_UNKNOWN_AND_GAP, dtype=dtype)
        push!(to_concat, (reshape(aatype_onehot, 1, size(aatype_onehot)...), 1))
        push!(to_concat, (reshape(aatype_onehot, size(aatype_onehot, 1), 1, size(aatype_onehot, 2)), 1))
        template_group_indices = RESTYPE_RIGIDGROUP_DENSE_ATOM_IDX[templates.aatype .+ 1, :, :]
        rigid, backbone_mask = make_backbone_rigid(Vec3Array_from_array(dense_atom_positions), dense_atom_mask, convert.(Int32, template_group_indices))
        points = rigid.translation
        rigid_vec = inverse(reshape(rigid, length(rigid), 1)) .* points
        unit_vector = normalized(rigid_vec)
        unit_vector = [unit_vector.x, unit_vector.y, unit_vector.z]
        unit_vector = [convert.(dtype, x) for x in unit_vector]
        backbone_mask = convert.(dtype, backbone_mask)
        backbone_mask_2d = backbone_mask[:, :] .* backbone_mask[:, :]'
        backbone_mask_2d = backbone_mask_2d .* multichain_mask_2d
        unit_vector = [x .* backbone_mask_2d for x in unit_vector]
        for x in unit_vector
            push!(to_concat, (x, 0))
        end
        push!(to_concat, (backbone_mask_2d, 0))
        query_embedding = LayerNorm(name="query_embedding_norm")(query_embedding)
        push!(to_concat, (query_embedding, 1))
        act = zeros(dtype, size(query_embedding, 1), size(query_embedding, 2), num_channels)
        for (i, (x, n_input_dims)) in enumerate(to_concat)
            act .+= Linear(num_channels, num_input_dims=n_input_dims, initializer="relu", name="template_pair_embedding_$(i)")(x)
        end
        return act
    end
    act = construct_input(query_embedding, templates, multichain_mask_2d)
    if c.template_stack.num_layer > 0
        function template_iteration_fn(x)
            return PairFormerIteration(c.template_stack, gc, name="template_embedding_iteration")(act=x, pair_mask=padding_mask_2d)
        end
        template_stack = layer_stack(c.template_stack.num_layer)(template_iteration_fn)
        act = template_stack(act)
    end
    act = LayerNorm(name="output_layer_norm")(act)
    return act
end

using Test

abstract type StructureTestCase end

function assertAuthorNamingSchemeEqual(test_case, ans1, ans2)
    if isnothing(ans1) || isnothing(ans2)
        @test isnothing(ans1)
        @test isnothing(ans2)
        return
    end
    flat_ans1 = Dict(flatten_with_path(asdict(ans1)))
    flat_ans2 = Dict(flatten_with_path(asdict(ans2)))
    for (k, v) in flat_ans1
        @test v == flat_ans2[k]
    end
    for (k, v) in flat_ans2
        @test v == flat_ans1[k]
    end
end

function assertAllResiduesEqual(test_case, all_res1, all_res2)
    if isnothing(all_res1) || isnothing(all_res2)
        @test isnothing(all_res1)
        @test isnothing(all_res2)
        return
    end
    @test Set(keys(all_res1)) == Set(keys(all_res2))
    for (chain_id, chain_res) in all_res1
        @test chain_res == all_res2[chain_id]
    end
end

function assertBioassemblyDataEqual(test_case, data1, data2)
    if isnothing(data1) || isnothing(data2)
        @test isnothing(data1)
        @test isnothing(data2)
        return
    end
    @test to_mmcif_dict(data1) == to_mmcif_dict(data2)
end

function assertChemicalComponentsDataEqual(test_case, data1, data2, allow_chem_comp_data_extension)
    if isnothing(data1) || isnothing(data2)
        @test isnothing(data1)
        @test isnothing(data2)
        return
    end
    if (!allow_chem_comp_data_extension) || (!isempty(symdiff(keys(data1.chem_comp), keys(data2.chem_comp))))
        @test data1.chem_comp == data2.chem_comp
    else
        mismatching_values = []
        for component_id in keys(data1.chem_comp)
            found = data1.chem_comp[component_id]
            expected = data2.chem_comp[component_id]
            if !extends(found, expected)
                push!(mismatching_values, (component_id, expected, found))
            end
        end
        if !isempty(mismatching_values)
            mismatch_err_msgs = join(["$(component_id): $(expected) or its extension expected, but $(found) found." for (component_id, expected, found) in mismatching_values], "\n")
            error("Mismatching values for `_chem_comp` table: $(mismatch_err_msgs)")
        end
    end
end

function assertBondsEqual(test_case, bonds1, bonds2, atom_key1, atom_key2)
    if isnothing(bonds1) || length(bonds1) == 0 || isnothing(bonds2) || length(bonds2) == 0
        @test isnothing(bonds1) || length(bonds1) == 0
        @test isnothing(bonds2) || length(bonds2) == 0
        return
    end
    ptnr1_indices1, ptnr2_indices1 = get_atom_indices(bonds1, atom_key1)
    ptnr1_indices2, ptnr2_indices2 = get_atom_indices(bonds2, atom_key2)
    @test ptnr1_indices1 == ptnr1_indices2
    @test ptnr2_indices1 == ptnr2_indices2
    @test bonds1.type == bonds2.type
    @test bonds1.role == bonds2.role
end

function assertStructuresEqual(test_case, struc1, struc2; ignore_fields=nothing, allow_chem_comp_data_extension=false, atol=0)
    for field in sort(collect(GLOBAL_FIELDS))
        if !isnothing(ignore_fields) && field in ignore_fields
            continue
        end
        if field == "author_naming_scheme"
            assertAuthorNamingSchemeEqual(test_case, getfield(struc1, Symbol(field)), getfield(struc2, Symbol(field)))
        elseif field == "all_residues"
            assertAllResiduesEqual(test_case, getfield(struc1, Symbol(field)), getfield(struc2, Symbol(field)))
        elseif field == "bioassembly_data"
            assertBioassemblyDataEqual(test_case, getfield(struc1, Symbol(field)), getfield(struc2, Symbol(field)))
        elseif field == "chemical_components_data"
            assertChemicalComponentsDataEqual(test_case, getfield(struc1, Symbol(field)), getfield(struc2, Symbol(field)), allow_chem_comp_data_extension)
        elseif field == "bonds"
            assertBondsEqual(test_case, struc1.bonds, struc2.bonds, struc1.atom_key, struc2.atom_key)
        else
            @test getfield(struc1, Symbol(field)) == getfield(struc2, Symbol(field))
        end
    end
    num_atoms = struc1.num_atoms
    @test struc2.num_atoms == num_atoms
    struc1 = order_and_drop_atoms_to_match(struc1, struc2)
    @test struc1.num_atoms == num_atoms
    for field in sort(collect(ARRAY_FIELDS))
        if field == "atom_key"
            continue
        end
        if !isnothing(ignore_fields) && field in ignore_fields
            continue
        end
        @test isnothing(getfield(struc1, Symbol(field))) == isnothing(getfield(struc2, Symbol(field)))
        field_val_1 = getfield(struc1, Symbol(field))
        field_val_2 = getfield(struc2, Symbol(field))
        if eltype(field_val_1) <: AbstractFloat
            @test isapprox(field_val_1, field_val_2, atol=atol)
        else
            @test field_val_1 == field_val_2
        end
    end

using Base.Filesystem

struct NotFoundError <: Exception
    msg::String
end

mutable struct StructureStore
    structure_mapping::Union{Dict{String, String}, Nothing}
    structure_path::Union{String, Nothing}
    structure_tar::Union{Any, Nothing}
    tar_members::Union{Dict{String, Any}, Nothing}
    
    function StructureStore(structures)
        if isa(structures, Dict)
            return new(structures, nothing, nothing, nothing)
        else
            path_str = string(structures)
            if endswith(path_str, ".tar")
                tar_file = open_tar(path_str, "r")
                instance = new(nothing, nothing, tar_file, nothing)
                return instance
            else
                return new(nothing, path_str, nothing, nothing)
            end
        end
    end
end

function get_tar_members(store::StructureStore)
    if isnothing(store.tar_members)
        @assert !isnothing(store.structure_tar)
        members = Dict{String, Any}()
        for tarinfo in get_members(store.structure_tar)
            if is_file(tarinfo)
                path = lowercase(tarinfo.path)
                if endswith(path, ".cif")
                    stem = splitext(basename(path))[1]
                    members[stem] = tarinfo
                end
            end
        end
        return members
    else
        return store.tar_members
    end
end

function get_mmcif_str(store::StructureStore, target_name::String)::String
    if !isnothing(store.structure_mapping)
        try
            return store.structure_mapping[target_name]
        catch e
            throw(NotFoundError("target_name=$(target_name) not found"))
        end
    end
    if !isnothing(store.structure_tar)
        try
            members = get_tar_members(store)
            member = members[target_name]
            struct_file = extract_file(store.structure_tar, member)
            if !isnothing(struct_file)
                return String(read(struct_file))
            else
                throw(NotFoundError("target_name=$(target_name) not found"))
            end
        catch e
            throw(NotFoundError("target_name=$(target_name) not found"))
        end
    end
    filepath = joinpath(store.structure_path, "$(target_name).cif")
    try
        return read(filepath, String)
    catch e
        throw(NotFoundError("target_name=$(target_name) not found at filepath=$(filepath)"))
    end
end

function target_names(store::StructureStore)::Vector{String}
    if !isnothing(store.structure_mapping)
        return collect(keys(store.structure_mapping))
    elseif !isnothing(store.structure_tar)
        return sort(collect(keys(get_tar_members(store))))
    elseif !isnothing(store.structure_path)
        files = readdir(store.structure_path)
        cif_files = filter(f -> endswith(f, ".cif"), files)
        stems = [splitext(f)[1] for f in cif_files]
        return sort(stems)
    end
    return String[]
end

struct AlignmentError <: Exception
    msg::String
end

function realign_hit_to_structure(; hit_sequence::String, hit_start_index::Int, hit_end_index::Int, full_length::Int, structure_sequence::String, query_to_hit_mapping::Dict{Int, Int})::Dict{Int, Int}
    max_num_gaps = full_length - length(structure_sequence)
    if max_num_gaps < 0
        throw(AlignmentError("The Structure sequence ($(length(structure_sequence))) must be shorter than the PDB seqres sequence ($(full_length)):\nStructure sequence : $(structure_sequence)\nPDB seqres sequence: $(hit_sequence)"))
    end
    if length(hit_sequence) != hit_end_index - hit_start_index
        throw(AlignmentError("The difference of hit_end_index=$(hit_end_index) and hit_start_index=$(hit_start_index) does not equal to the length of the hit_sequence: $(length(hit_sequence))"))
    end
    best_score = -1
    best_start = 0
    best_query_to_hit_mapping = query_to_hit_mapping
    max_num_gaps_before_subseq = min(hit_start_index, max_num_gaps)
    for num_gaps_before_subseq in 0:max_num_gaps_before_subseq
        start = hit_start_index - num_gaps_before_subseq
        end_idx = hit_end_index - num_gaps_before_subseq
        structure_subseq = structure_sequence[start+1:end_idx]
        new_query_to_hit_mapping, score = _remap_to_struc_seq(hit_seq=hit_sequence, struc_seq=structure_subseq, max_num_gaps=max_num_gaps - num_gaps_before_subseq, mapping=query_to_hit_mapping)
        if score >= best_score
            best_score = score
            best_start = start
            best_query_to_hit_mapping = new_query_to_hit_mapping
        end
    end
    return Dict(q => h + best_start for (q, h) in best_query_to_hit_mapping)
end

function _remap_to_struc_seq(; hit_seq::String, struc_seq::String, max_num_gaps::Int, mapping::Dict{Int, Int})::Tuple{Dict{Int, Int}, Int}
    hit_seq_idx = 1
    struc_seq_idx = 1
    hit_to_struc_seq_mapping = Dict{Int, Int}()
    score = 0
    remaining_num_gaps = max_num_gaps
    while hit_seq_idx <= length(hit_seq) && struc_seq_idx <= length(struc_seq)
        if hit_seq[hit_seq_idx] != struc_seq[struc_seq_idx]
            best_shift = 0
            for shift in 0:remaining_num_gaps
                if hit_seq_idx + shift <= length(hit_seq)
                    next_hit_res = hit_seq[hit_seq_idx + shift:hit_seq_idx + shift]
                else
                    next_hit_res = ""
                end
                if struc_seq_idx <= length(struc_seq)
                    next_struc_res = struc_seq[struc_seq_idx:struc_seq_idx]
                else
                    next_struc_res = ""
                end
                if next_hit_res == next_struc_res
                    best_shift = shift
                    break
                end
            end
            hit_seq_idx += best_shift
            remaining_num_gaps -= best_shift
        end
        hit_to_struc_seq_mapping[hit_seq_idx] = struc_seq_idx
        score += (hit_seq[hit_seq_idx] == struc_seq[struc_seq_idx]) ? 1 : 0
        hit_seq_idx += 1
        struc_seq_idx += 1
    end
    fixed_mapping = Dict{Int, Int}()
    for (query_idx, original_hit_idx) in mapping
        fixed_hit_idx = get(hit_to_struc_seq_mapping, original_hit_idx, nothing)
        if !isnothing(fixed_hit_idx)
            fixed_mapping[query_idx] = fixed_hit_idx
        end
    end
    return fixed_mapping, score
end

using Base: @kwdef

function get_item(instance, key)
    sliced = Dict()
    for field in get_array_fields(instance)
        num_trailing_dims = get(field.metadata, "num_trailing_dims", 0)
        this_key = key
        if isa(key, Tuple) && (Colon() in this_key)
            this_key = tuple(this_key..., repeat([Colon()], num_trailing_dims)...)
        end
        sliced[field.name] = map(x -> x[this_key...], getfield(instance, Symbol(field.name)))
    end
    return reconstruct(instance, sliced)
end

function get_shape(instance)
    fields = fieldnames(typeof(instance))
    first_field = fields[1]
    first_field_info = nothing
    for f in field_info(typeof(instance))
        if f.name == string(first_field)
            first_field_info = f
            break
        end
    end
    num_trailing_dims = get(first_field_info.metadata, "num_trailing_dims", nothing)
    value = getfield(instance, first_field)
    if !isnothing(num_trailing_dims)
        return size(value)[1:end-num_trailing_dims]
    else
        return size(value)
    end
end

function get_len(instance)
    shape = get_shape(instance)
    if length(shape) > 0
        return shape[1]
    else
        error("len() of unsized object")
    end
end

function get_dtype(instance)
    fields = field_info(typeof(instance))
    sets_dtype = [f.name for f in fields if get(f.metadata, "sets_dtype", false)]
    if !isempty(sets_dtype)
        @assert length(sets_dtype) == 1 "at most one field can set dtype"
        field_value = getfield(instance, Symbol(sets_dtype[1]))
    elseif instance.same_dtype
        field_value = getfield(instance, fieldnames(typeof(instance))[1])
    else
        error("Trying to access Dtype on Struct of Array without either \"same_dtype\" or field setting dtype")
    end
    if hasproperty(field_value, :dtype)
        return field_value.dtype
    else
        error("field_value $(field_value) does not have dtype")
    end
end

function replace_fields(instance; kwargs...)
    return reconstruct(instance, Dict(String(k) => v for (k, v) in kwargs))
end

function post_init(instance)
    array_fields = get_array_fields(instance)
    arrays = collect(values(get_array_fields(instance, return_values=true)))
    first_field = array_fields[1]
    try
        dtype = get_dtype(instance)
    catch
        dtype = nothing
    end
    if !isnothing(dtype)
        first_shape = get_shape(instance)
        for (array, field) in zip(arrays, array_fields)
            num_trailing_dims = get(field.metadata, "num_trailing_dims", nothing)
            if !isnothing(num_trailing_dims)
                array_shape = size(array)
                field_shape = array_shape[1:end-num_trailing_dims]
                msg = "field $(field) should have number of trailing dims $(num_trailing_dims)"
                @assert length(array_shape) == length(first_shape) + num_trailing_dims msg
            else
                field_shape = size(array)
            end
            shape_msg = "Stripped Shape $(field_shape) of field $(field) doesn't match shape $(first_shape) of field $(first_field)"
            @assert field_shape == first_shape shape_msg
            field_dtype = eltype(array)
            allowed_metadata_dtypes = get(field.metadata, "allowed_dtypes", [])
            if !isempty(allowed_metadata_dtypes)
                msg = "Dtype is $(field_dtype) but must be in $(allowed_metadata_dtypes)"
                @assert field_dtype in allowed_metadata_dtypes msg
            end
            if haskey(field.metadata, "dtype")
                target_dtype = field.metadata["dtype"]
            else
                target_dtype = dtype
            end
            msg = "Dtype is $(field_dtype) but must be $(target_dtype)"
            @assert field_dtype == target_dtype msg
        end
    end
end

function flatten_struct(instance)
    array_likes = values(get_array_fields(instance, return_values=true))
    flat_array_likes = []
    inner_treedefs = []
    num_arrays = []
    for array_like in array_likes
        flat_array_like, inner_treedef = tree_flatten(array_like)
        push!(inner_treedefs, inner_treedef)
        append!(flat_array_likes, flat_array_like)
        push!(num_arrays, length(flat_array_like))
    end
    metadata = get_metadata_fields(instance, return_values=true)
    metadata = typeof(instance).metadata_cls(; metadata...)
    return flat_array_likes, (inner_treedefs, metadata, num_arrays)
end

function make_metadata_class(cls)
    metadata_fields = get_fields(cls, x -> get(x.metadata, "is_metadata", false))
    metadata_cls = create_dataclass("Meta" * string(cls), [(field.name, field.type, field) for field in metadata_fields], frozen=true, eq=true)
    return metadata_cls
end

function get_fields(cls_or_instance, filterfn; return_values=false)
    fields = field_info(typeof(cls_or_instance))
    fields = [field for field in fields if filterfn(field)]
    if return_values
        return Dict(field.name => getfield(cls_or_instance, Symbol(field.name)) for field in fields)
    else
        return fields
    end
end

function get_array_fields(cls; return_values=false)
    return get_fields(cls, x -> !get(x.metadata, "is_metadata", false), return_values=return_values)
end

function get_metadata_fields(cls; return_values=false)
    return get_fields(cls, x -> get(x.metadata, "is_metadata", false), return_values=return_values)
end

struct StructOfArray
    same_dtype::Bool
    StructOfArray(; same_dtype=true) = new(same_dtype)
end

function (decorator::StructOfArray)(cls)
    setfield!(cls, :__array_ufunc__, nothing)
    setfield!(cls, :replace, replace_fields)
    setfield!(cls, :same_dtype, decorator.same_dtype)
    setfield!(cls, :dtype, get_dtype)
    setfield!(cls, :shape, get_shape)
    setfield!(cls, :__len__, get_len)
    setfield!(cls, :__getitem__, get_item)
    setfield!(cls, :__post_init__, post_init)
    new_cls = make_dataclass(cls, frozen=true, eq=false)
    new_cls.metadata_cls = make_metadata_class(new_cls)
    function unflatten(aux, data)
        inner_treedefs, metadata, num_arrays = aux
        array_fields = [field.name for field in get_array_fields(new_cls)]
        value_dict = Dict()
        array_start = 1
        for (num_array, inner_treedef, array_field) in zip(num_arrays, inner_treedefs, array_fields)
            value_dict[array_field] = tree_unflatten(inner_treedef, data[array_start:array_start + num_array - 1])
            array_start += num_array
        end
        metadata_fields = get_metadata_fields(new_cls)
        for field in metadata_fields
            value_dict[field.name] = getfield(metadata, Symbol(field.name))
        end
        return new_cls(; (Symbol(k) => v for (k, v) in value_dict)...)
    end
    register_pytree_node(new_cls, flatten_func=flatten_struct, unflatten_func=unflatten)
    return new_cls
end

const JNP_TO_TL_DTYPES = Dict(
    Bool => :int1,
    Int8 => :int8,
    Int16 => :int16,
    Int32 => :int32,
    Int64 => :int64,
    UInt8 => :uint8,
    UInt16 => :uint16,
    UInt32 => :uint32,
    UInt64 => :uint64,
    Float16 => :float16,
    BFloat16 => :bfloat16,
    Float32 => :float32,
    Float64 => :float64
)

function jnp_to_tl_dtype(jnp_dtype)
    return JNP_TO_TL_DTYPES[jnp_dtype]
end

function get_tl_dot_fn(precision)
    if !is_precision_supported(precision)
        error("Unsupported dot precision: $(precision)")
    end
    if precision == DotPrecision_TF32_F32_3X
        return _dot_tf32_f32_3x
    end
    in_dtype = jnp_to_tl_dtype(precision.operand_dtype)
    out_dtype = jnp_to_tl_dtype(precision.accumulator_dtype)
    allow_tf32 = (precision == DotPrecision_TF32_F32)
    function _dot_fn(a, b; trans_a=false, trans_b=false, _builder=nothing)
        if in_dtype == :float32
            @assert eltype(a) == Float32
            @assert eltype(b) == Float32
        else
            @assert eltype(a) <: AbstractFloat
            @assert eltype(b) <: AbstractFloat
        end
        a = convert_dtype(a, in_dtype, _builder=_builder)
        b = convert_dtype(b, in_dtype, _builder=_builder)
        a = trans_a ? transpose(a) : a
        b = trans_b ? transpose(b) : b
        return dot_operation(a, b, allow_tf32=allow_tf32, out_dtype=out_dtype, _builder=_builder)
    end
    return _dot_fn
end

function is_precision_supported(precision)
    return precision in [
        DotPrecision_F32_F32,
        DotPrecision_TF32_F32,
        DotPrecision_F16_F32,
        DotPrecision_BF16_F32,
        DotPrecision_TF32_F32_3X
    ]
end

function _dot_tf32_f32_3x(a, b; trans_a=false, trans_b=false)
    @assert eltype(a) == Float32
    @assert eltype(b) == Float32
    a_ = reinterpret.(Float32, reinterpret.(UInt32, a) .& 0xFFFFE000)
    b_ = reinterpret.(Float32, reinterpret.(UInt32, b) .& 0xFFFFE000)
    a_err = a .- a_
    b_err = b .- b_
    if trans_a
        a_ = transpose(a_)
        a_err = transpose(a_err)
    end
    if trans_b
        b_ = transpose(b_)
        b_err = transpose(b_err)
    end
    return dot_f32(a_, b_) .+ (dot_f32(a_, b_err) .+ dot_f32(a_err, b_))
end

function has_triton_support()
    if default_backend() != "gpu"
        return false
    end
    return parse(Float64, compute_capability(devices()[1])) >= 8.0
end

        run(pipeline(`$jackhmmer_path -h --seq_limit 1`, stdout=devnull, stderr=devnull))
        return true

function run_command(cmd::Vector{String}, cmd_name::String; log_on_process_error::Bool=false, log_stderr::Bool=false, log_stdout::Bool=false, max_out_streams_len::Union{Int, Nothing}=500000, kwargs...)
    @info "Launching subprocess \"$(join(cmd, " "))\""
    start_time = time()
    try
        result = run(pipeline(Cmd(cmd), stdout=IOBuffer(), stderr=IOBuffer()); wait=true, kwargs...)
        stdout_content = String(take!(result.stdout))
        stderr_content = String(take!(result.stderr))
        completed_process = (stdout=stdout_content, stderr=stderr_content, returncode=0)
    catch e
        if log_on_process_error
            @error "$(cmd_name) failed. $(cmd_name) stderr begin:"
            for error_line in split(e.stderr, "\n")
                stripped_error_line = strip(error_line)
                if !isempty(stripped_error_line)
                    @error stripped_error_line
                end
            end
            @error "$(cmd_name) stderr end."
        end
        stdout_trunc = !isnothing(max_out_streams_len) ? e.stdout[1:min(end, max_out_streams_len)] : e.stdout
        stderr_trunc = !isnothing(max_out_streams_len) ? e.stderr[1:min(end, max_out_streams_len)] : e.stderr
        error_msg = "$(cmd_name) failed\nstdout:\n$(stdout_trunc)\n\nstderr:\n$(stderr_trunc)"
        error(error_msg)
    end
    end_time = time()
    @info "Finished $(cmd_name) in $(round(end_time - start_time, digits=3)) seconds"
    stdout_val, stderr_val = completed_process.stdout, completed_process.stderr
    if log_stdout && !isempty(stdout_val)
        @info "$(cmd_name) stdout:\n$(stdout_val)"
    end
    if log_stderr && !isempty(stderr_val)
        @info "$(cmd_name) stderr:\n$(stderr_val)"
    end
    return completed_process
end
